Then each notice of the case is answered with its person key and the call writes nothing

  Scenario: AC14 Error answers of the provided operations (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a business date with no quality run
    When a caller with the Platform administration right reads GET /quality-runs/{business date} for that date
    Then the response is 404 and nothing is written
    Then a call without a token gets 401 as in AC12, and a call from a role without the right gets 403 as in AC10

  Scenario: AC15 Activity retry and timeout (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the reconciliation activity of the quality run of 2026-11-30 fails once and is retried
    When the retry completes
    Then comms_quality_result holds one row per check and business date and no row is written twice
    Given the reconciliation activity of the quality run of 2026-11-30 exceeds its timeout
    When the timeout is reached
    Then no quality result is written for 2026-11-30 and the run state of 2026-11-30 is FAILED with the system named
